sentences.text: In order to arrive at the above sumsconclusion, the Tribunal has assessed his monthly income at Rs.19,300/- and has assessed the disability at 10%.

3. The claimant is in appeal contending that two Doctors had been examined and both of them have treated the claimant and they have stated that the claimant had suffered 24% and 17% disability to the whole body and therefore, the assessment of the Tribunal was incorrect.

In my view, since the Orthopaedic Surgeon who has examined, has clearly stated that the claimant has suffered the disability at 24% to the whole body, and hence, it would be appropriate to determine the whole body disability at 24%.
4. The Tribunal has taken the monthly income correctly at Rs.19,300/- based on the pay slips that are produced before it.
Since the claimant had suffered disability in excess of 20% i.e., 24%, 25% of the monthly income would be added as his future prospects to the said income.
5. As the claimant was aged 42 years, a multiplier of '14' would have to be applied.

Consequently, the claimant would be entitled to a sum of Rs.9,72,720/- [Rs.19,300/- + (Rs.19,300/- x25%)=
Rs.24,125/- x 12 x 24% x 14] towards 'loss of future income' .

6. The Tribunal has awarded Rs.60,000/- towards 'pain and sufferings' and Rs.20,000/- towards future amenities, which is meagre, and hence, it would be appropriate to award a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- towards 'pain and sufferings' and Rs.75,000/- towards loss of future amenities.
7. The evidence on records indicates that the claimant was hospitalised for 82 days and also on four occasions.
The Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.40,000/- towards 'food, conveyance and attendant charges'.

In my view it would be appropriate to award Rs.75,000/- towards conveyance,
attendant, food and nutrition.
8. The Tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.142,090/- towards medical expenses and a sum of Rs.20,000/- towards future medical expenses.
A sum of Rs.57,900/- is awarded towards 'loss of income during laid up period' .
All these sums are just and proper and do not require any enhancement.
9. Consequently, the award of the Tribunal is modified and the following sums are awarded as compensation:
